findings.issue: `hsq`, `hnear` and `hψ'` copy `hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian_eventuallyEq` and `hasFDerivAt_hamiltonianFlow_radialHamiltonian_center` (RadialTwist.lean:229-246) almost verbatim, with the sum Hamiltonian in place of the single one.
